name: ht-ml.app
summary: HTML hosting with an API for AI agents: POST one HTML document and get a public URL back instantly.
description: An API-first static host for single HTML documents. An agent POSTs html_content to /v1/sites and the page goes live at its own {site_id}.ht-ml.app subdomain, with an update_key bearer token for later edits, asset uploads and optional password protection. No accounts or dashboards; llms.txt and a self-describing /v1/help document the endpoints, and an installable agent skill bundles 20 page templates.
contains: POST /v1/sites publishes HTML and returns site_id, update_key and url
update_key bearer token for PUT updates and for uploading referenced assets
Optional per-site password with owner-only reads for protected sites
Self-describing /v1/help JSON plus an llms.txt reference
Installable agent skill (Claude Code, Codex and other clients) with 20 page templates
Guides: single-file kanban board, ghtml blog, deploy in one command
